title: DOWNED BAR
why: His order: a mechanic like the active reload for when you are downed. A bar with a white slider sweeps back and forth once a second above the DOWN title, with a red sweet spot in the middle, a fifth of the bar. Press fire (left mouse, or the right trigger) while the slider is in the red and your bleed-out runs at half speed for a little over a second; keep hitting about once a second and you keep bleeding slowly. A press outside the red makes a dull sound, flashes the bar red and locks the trigger for 0.3 seconds, nothing more. A trigger held down as you fell does not count until you let go and pull again. Revive, self-revive and surrendering work exactly as before, and the bar is gone the moment you are up, dead or out.
now: When downed, hit fire with the slider in the red to bleed out at half speed.
